UNAUTHENTICATED: Send HelloRequest with a valid pairing token first; run `edge-daemon pair` for a local code.
ORIGIN_REJECTED: Open the app from an allowed origin, or add it to EDGE_ALLOWED_ORIGINS in the daemon config.
SAFETY_BLOCKED: This service is gated: reconnect in ACTIVE_CONFIRMED mode and confirm the action first.
TOKEN_INVALID: Safety tokens are single-use and expire in 60 s; confirm the action again to get a new one.
PRECONDITION_UNKNOWN: Speed, RPM or battery voltage could not be read; check the ignition is on and the adapter is connected.
LEASE_REQUIRED: This feature needs a Pro or Workshop lease; sign in online once to refresh it.
ADAPTER_ERROR: Check the adapter is plugged in and not in use by another program, then reconnect.
PROTOCOL_ERROR: The vehicle did not answer as expected; try a different protocol or AUTO.
TIMEOUT: No reply in time; check the ignition is on and the cable is seated, then retry.
VERSION_UNSUPPORTED: The app and edge daemon versions are incompatible; update the edge daemon.
LAN_UNAVAILABLE: Phone access is set up on the PC: run `edge-daemon lan enable`, restart the daemon, then pair the phone from Devices.
